name: Mist
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach.

She raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
narrative.objectives: Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, thank you, adventurer! I feared I would never see Mist again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.
narrative.requestItemsText: Mist... It was my fault! The witches caught me off guard... I should not have let them take you...
narrative.endText: Lead Mist safely to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
